products.title: Shenmue III Enhanced - Special Edition (Nintendo Switch 2)
products.body_html:
Special Edition Contents

This Special Limited Edition offers additional insights into Shenmue III.

  • Physical Game + Printed Manual (Full Color)
    Officially licensed Nintendo Switch 2 (full physical cartridge) release with a reversible cover. Includes a beautiful, retro-inspired full-color printed manual filled with artwork, game information, and classic Shenmue-style presentation.

  • Special Edition Box
    A high-quality, collectible box designed exclusively for the Special Edition, ideal for display and safekeeping.

  • Blu-ray Documentary (Jewel Case)
    An in-depth behind-the-scenes documentary on Blu-ray, featuring development insights, interviews, and exclusive footage from the creation of Shenmue III.

  • Special Edition Artbook
    A beautifully produced artbook showcasing concept art, characters, environments, and behind-the-scenes material that brings the world of Shenmue III to life.

Shenmue III – Enhanced Edition for Nintendo Switch 2 delivers the definitive version of Yu Suzuki’s iconic adventure, refined for modern platforms while staying true to its legendary roots. The NSW2 cartridge includes the full game.

This Enhanced Edition elevates the original experience with improved visuals, smoother performance, faster load times, and modern quality-of-life options—all fully optional, ensuring the classic Shenmue feel remains intact for purists while welcoming new players.

A must-have for collectors and fans alike, Shenmue III Enhanced is the definitive way to continue Ryo Hazuki’s unforgettable journey.

Set in a beautifully realized world inspired by rural China, Shenmue III Enhanced delivers a slow-burn, immersive experience centered on exploration, storytelling, and everyday life. As Ryo Hazuki, players investigate mysteries, train in authentic martial arts, interact with fully voiced characters, and uncover secrets at their own pace. Dynamic weather, NPCs with daily routines, and a wealth of optional activities bring the world to life with remarkable authenticity.

Shenmue III Enhanced Features

  • A Living Open World Adventure
    Explore a detailed, story-driven world with daily NPC routines, mini-games, and immersive side activities.

  • Epic Story by Yu Suzuki
    Continue Ryo Hazuki’s journey in a narrative-focused blend of mystery, exploration, and martial arts.

  • Authentic Martial Arts Gameplay
    Train, learn techniques, and engage in real-time combat that rewards skill and preparation.

  • Enhanced Visuals & Performance
    Sharper textures, smoother gameplay, and faster load times for the best Shenmue III experience yet.

  • Modern Enhancements, Optional by Design
    Quality-of-life improvements, accessibility options, and a classic camera mode — all fully toggleable.

  • The Definitive Shenmue III Experience
    The most refined and accessible version of Shenmue III for both newcomers and longtime fans.

products.title: R-Type Dimensions III - Special Edition (Nintendo Switch 2)
products.body_html:
Special Edition Contents

This Special Limited Edition offers additional insights to R-Type III.

Physical Game + Printed Manual (Full Color)

Officially licensed Nintendo Switch 2 game - with full game on cartridge, and a reversible cover.
Includes a beautiful retro-inspired printed manual filled with controls, lore, ship systems, Force breakdowns, stage briefs & tips.

Art Booklet

A high-quality soft cover book giving insights to:

  • Concept art to guide the visual journey of the remake

  • Behind-the-scenes designs 

  • Further information on ship with weapons, but also enemies and level designs

  • More insights with comments from developer and some references to early R-Type III marketing from the 90's

Original Soundtrack on CD

  • Newly rearranged orchestration & synth remixes created for R-Type Dimensions III

 

The legendary side-scrolling shoot ’em up returns — bigger, bolder, and far more dangerous than ever before on Nintendo Switch 2.

R-Type Dimensions III is a full-scale reimagining of R-Type III: The Third Lightning, Irem’s cult 1993 console-exclusive masterpiece. Every infamous stage, every grotesque Bydo monstrosity, every cruel trap and rotating biomechanical nightmare has been rebuilt with modern 3D graphics, a rearranged soundtrack, and an arsenal of new features. Yet beneath the new polish beats the same sadistic heart of the SNES classic.

Fans of the original will feel right at home — and completely terrified.

As the pilot of the cutting-edge R-90 “Ragnarok”, you embark on the Third Bydo Mission armed with Wave Cannons, Bits, and one of the most defining mechanics in shmup history: the Force unit. The original R-Type III was the first in the series to introduce multiple Force types (Round, Shadow, and Cyclone), each radically altering how the game is played. These return here in stunning detail, with effects and animations faithful to their 16-bit personalities.

Now, more than 30 years later, you can experience this classic in two completely different dimensions — instantly.

With the push of a button, swap between authentic pixel-perfect 2D visuals and fully reimagined 3D graphics, complete with dynamic lighting, modern effects, animated environments, and cinematic camera flourishes.
No loading. No interruption. Just pure dimensional shift.

For hardcore fans, this remake includes nods to the original SNES secrets, visual homages to Tamtex’s clever Mode 7 trickery, reinterpreted boss-entry animations, and environmental details inspired by Japanese design notes and old developer commentary. (Yes, that infamous Stage 2 censorship oddity? It’s referenced in a clever way. Yes, the lava labyrinth in Stage 4 is still agonizing. No, the Force pod still won’t protect you from everything.)

Prepare to face the Bydo as you’ve never seen them before — or exactly as you remember them.

Either way, you’re going to die. A lot.

New Features in R-Type Dimensions III

Advanced Mode – A New Level of Pain
The entire campaign re-engineered for maximum brutality.

  • Faster enemy movement

  • Denser projectile patterns

  • Remixed waves and boss variants
    It’s the closest thing to a modern arcade “Ultra Mode” 

2-Player Local Co-op – Bring a Wingman
Coordinate your Forces, stagger your Wave Cannon charges, and relive the golden age of cooperative shmups — all from your couch.

Instant 2D/3D Switch – Reality Is Optional
Tap once to switch between:

  • Classic SNES-style pixel art, meticulously recreated

  • Dynamic 3D visuals with modern shaders, effects, and animated backgrounds
    Swap on the fly — even mid-boss — for an experience that feels both nostalgic and cutting-edge.

Multiple Difficulty Levels – For Trainees and Masochists Alike
From introductory settings for newcomers to brutal Expert Mode, every pilot can find their (un)comfort zone.

Online Leaderboards – Climb the Dimensional Ladder
Take your place among global R-Type aces.
Score-chasing returns with modern tracking and bragging rights.

Collector’s Edition Contents

This strictly limited CE celebrates not only the remake, but the legacy of R-Type III itself.

Premium Collector’s Edition Box

A heavy-duty, display-worthy box featuring newly commissioned artwork of Dobkeratops locked in a death duel with the R-90 Ragnarok. Metallic accents and embossing replicate the reflective style of 90s Japanese game packaging.

Physical Game + Printed Manual (Full Color)

A real, tangible release — as it should be, with full game on cartridge, an exclusive reversible cover, and a beautiful retro-inspired printed manual filled with controls, lore, ship systems, Force breakdowns, stage briefs & tips.

15 cm Resin Figurine – Dobkeratops vs. R-90 Ragnarok

A meticulously sculpted diorama capturing the series’ most iconic encounter: the biomechanical alien Dobkeratops emerging from its fleshy wall, facing off against the aggressive, angular R-90.
Includes:

  • Subtle texture nods to the SNES sprite shading

  • Force pod attachment in translucent resin

  • A base inspired by the Stage 1 corridor

120-Page Artbook – “Lightning Reborn”

A premium hardcover book loaded with:

  • Concept art for all 3D remakes of classic enemies

  • Force pod evolution studies

  • Boss anatomy breakdowns (yes, including Creature 666)

  • Pixel-to-3D comparisons for every stage

  • Developer commentary on reinterpreting Tamtex’s original tricks (like fake-Mode-7 rotation and tile animation cheats)

  • Archival references to early R-Type III marketing from 1993
    A deep dive for true shmup historians.

Two-Disc Soundtrack Set

  • Disc 1: Complete original SNES soundtrack, remastered

  • Disc 2: Newly rearranged orchestration & synth remixes created for R-Type Dimensions III
    Perfect for comparing 16-bit crunch to modern studio production.

Poster, Stickers & Boss Cards

  • Fold-Out Poster: Dual-sided — one side featuring modern key art, the other a retro schematic of the R-90 + all Force types

  • Sticker Sheet: Ships, Forces, emblems, Bydo creature silhouettes

  • Boss Card Set: High-quality cards featuring bosses, lore, attack patterns, and behind-the-scenes notes on how their behaviors were updated in Advanced Mode

Individually Numbered Certificate of Authenticity

Every CE is uniquely numbered — no two collectors share the same ID.
